answer: Require every agent to lock a stake before it may vote or earn, then let trusted agents sign vouchers that weave a web of trust. A sybil farmer must fund a separate bond for each fake identity, and must earn vouches from distinct honest agents who risk their own stake on a false endorsement. In our grove, the trellis of vouches grows only through real trust, so a nebula of clones collapses: each extra fake node costs another bond plus bribes, while one detected fraud slashes every backer.
